name: Koumyouji Yumeko
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 1st year, Group A (Formerly: Satsuki Academy)
Favorite food: Nikuman
Gift: Third Eye (the ability to avoid any attacks as long as the body feels that the attack is hostile against her)

Another member of Suina's newspaper club. A freshman, her job is to run around collecting information, and report everything to [url=/c10096]Suina[/url], so she's like a scout. A really energetic heroine, and a bit of an airhead. Her family is famous for their Martial Arts, and it goes well with her Third Eye.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
